description: Prepare a sealed-offer link (a "Make an offer" link and button for a listing) for something the user sells. Returns a confirm_url: the seller opens it, signs in with Google and confirms — only then is the link live. Never returns or needs a credential.

deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the last day for offers (Budapest time), within a year. Required for "single".

kind.description: "single": one unique item, best offer at the deadline wins. "multi": several units, every offer above the reserve wins one immediately.

listing_url.description: The https:// link of the listing, shown to buyers.

reserve_price.description: The lowest price the seller accepts, a whole number. Never shown to buyers.

what.description: What is being sold, 3–60 characters, e.g. "Andrássy út 12, 3rd floor flat".

name: reservoprix_create_offer_link
